name: Encora
description:
Fetches theatrical performance metadata from https://encora.it
You must provide your own API key

TV show libraries in Jellyfin now require Show/Tour/Episodes folders (e.g. Show/Tour/[recording folder]/file.ext).

- Guard all GetItemById lookups against empty Guid

- Auto-seed the collection cache on startup if empty or stale

- Add retry logic with exponential backoff for Encora API rate limits and transient connection errors
- Prioritize Encora API data as gospel over local/partial file metadata
- Improve season tour conflict resolution when multiple recordings resolve to different tours

- Fix phantom "Season N" ghost entries in Jellyfin caused by library scanner creating same-path / different-name duplicate season records
- Automatically purge same-path duplicate season rows during duplicate cleaning

- Resolve tour name for Encora-ID season folders directly, deferring season merge to avoid mid-refresh conflicts
- Stop blocking manual "Identify → search images" from returning results for items that already have a poster; automated overwrite protection unaffected

- Fix episodes appearing under the wrong Season on the Season detail page (stale cached season-number on the episode, not the real link)
- Fix two different Seasons under the same show sharing the same season number, causing their episode lists to blend together

- Enforce Encora episode naming and date-encoded IndexNumber on NFO-backed items
- Parse explicit recording dates from NFO title when folder path has an unknown day or month
- Add symlink source folder fallback when locating episode NFO files
- Fix season name overrides and automatic tour merging for non-Encora recordings
- Protect the active season during inline merges to prevent race conditions, and keep episode parent season indices synchronized

- Fix ffmpeg thumbnail generation hang with bounded timeout so stalled video seeks no longer discard episode metadata
- Self-heal Season fragmentation on every refresh inline, preventing multi-recording tours from re-fragmenting into individual seasons

- Add on-demand "Merge Duplicate/Same-Tour Seasons" scheduled task to consolidate fragmented seasons without requiring a full library scan
- Speed up season consolidation by operating directly on database rows

## What's New

* attempting to merge seasons for flat libraries

- Support Seasons published without a physical Season folder (S##E## in filename directly under recording folder via EncoraSeasonPatcher)
- Add manual tour assignment interface in TV configuration for non-Encora recordings via .encora-tour markers
- Never collapse Seasons that share a name but live in distinct physical directories
- Fix 32-bit integer overflow in Episode IndexNumber date calculation

## What's New

* Hopefully fixes for poster overwriting and season order/naming

## What's Changed

### Fixes
- Posters are now permanently protected from being re-fetched from StageMedia once an item has one, whether it was set by Encora automatically or picked/uploaded manually. Previously, this was re-evaluated on every refresh, so an existing poster could occasionally still get overwritten (e.g. during a scheduled library scan) if the item lookup used to check for it didn't resolve correctly. Now the first time Encora sees an item has a poster, it stamps it permanently and never touches it again, no matter what future refreshes do.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pekempy/Jellyfin.Plugin.Encora/compare/1.2.0.5...1.2.0.6

- Fix HasImage check by passing imageIndex=0 to BaseItem.HasImage
- Fix missing using directive in EncoraMusicAlbumMetadataProvider

## What's Changed

### New: Fallback poster
- Movies, Series and Seasons whose show has no poster available on StageMedia now fall back to a placeholder poster instead of ending up with no artwork at all. Applies both to the automatic poster fetch during a scan and to the "Replace Image" search dialog.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pekempy/Jellyfin.Plugin.Encora/compare/1.2.0.2...1.2.0.3

## What's Changed

### Fixes
- Jellyfin hot-loads a new plugin version into the running server without unloading the old one first, and the very first time that happens to touch this plugin's settings, Jellyfin's own config loader silently wipes them back to defaults (API keys, library selections, everything) rather than surfacing the failure. The plugin now keeps its own encrypted backup of your settings and automatically restores from it on startup if it ever detects the live configuration has been reset unexpectedly - so an update no longer means re-entering your API keys and re-configuring libraries from scratch.

### Security
- API keys are encrypted (AES-256-GCM) in the backup file using a key generated once per installation and stored separately with restricted file permissions, rather than sitting in plaintext.
- Sensitive values are masked in log output (only the first and last 3 characters shown) if they're ever referenced in diagnostics.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pekempy/Jellyfin.Plugin.Encora/compare/1.2.0.1...1.2.0.2

## What's Changed

### New: Manually match a Series to Encora
- Series can now be matched to Encora directly via Jellyfin's normal **Identify** flow, instead of only ever being auto-bootstrapped from a recording found on disk. Search by show name, pick the right result, and the Series name/overview/poster are populated straight from Encora - this works even for a series folder that doesn't (yet) contain any Encora-identifiable recordings.
- Once identified this way, posters continue to be searchable afterwards via the existing StageMedia image provider, same as automatically-matched shows.
- Season and Episode matching are unaffected by this - they still only match recordings that carry a real Encora ID, and unidentified (`{ne}`) recordings are left alone.

### Fixes
- Jellyfin's own library scanner can occasionally leave two Season records behind for the same tour - a race that surfaces when several recordings under one season folder get processed concurrently during a scan, leaving one Season with a stale, partial episode count alongside the real one (e.g. two "Broadway" seasons on the same show, one incomplete). A new automatic pass now runs immediately after every library scan finishes, detects same-named duplicate Seasons under a Series, and removes the stale one. Only database records are touched - files on disk are never affected, so anything real is cleanly re-attached on the next scan.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pekempy/Jellyfin.Plugin.Encora/compare/1.1.0.1...1.2.0.0

## What's Changed

### Subtitles
- Replaced automatic subtitle downloading (previously fired as a side effect of a metadata refresh) with a proper Jellyfin `ISubtitleProvider` implementation. "Encora" now appears as a normal subtitle provider - alongside e.g. OpenSubtitles - in each library's **Manage Library → Subtitles** tab, participates in Jellyfin's own subtitle search UI and the "Download missing subtitles" scheduled task, and follows whatever "save subtitles with media" setting you already have configured.
- Removed the now-redundant per-library "Download subtitles" toggle from plugin settings (Movie/TV).

### Fixes
- TV libraries with a flat structure (episode files directly under the Series folder, no per-tour subfolder) previously got a season literally named "Season Unknown" with no further metadata applied. It's now renamed using the Series' own matched recording as a fallback, since there's no season folder of its own to scan for a tour.
- Fixed a shell-injection risk in the manifest-update publish workflow: release-note markdown containing backticks was being spliced directly into a `run:` script, letting bash interpret it as command substitution. Release bodies are now passed through `env:` and `jq --arg`/`--argjson` instead of being interpolated into script/jq text.
- Fixed GitHub Actions workflows (build, test, CodeQL, changelog draft) that were still triggering only on pushes to `master` and silently never ran after the repository's default branch was renamed to `main`. Also fixed a leftover `master` reference in the plugin catalog's banner image URL.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pekempy/Jellyfin.Plugin.Encora/compare/1.1.0.0...1.1.0.1

## What's Changed

### New library types
- Added TV Show library support: Series = the show, Season = the tour, Episode = a recording date.
- Added Music library support: Artist = the show, Album = one recording (tour + date), Track = an Act (or the full recording, if not split).
- Four supported ID-matching conventions (ID in filename, ID in folder name, `.encora-<id>` marker, `.encora-id` file), each documented per library type in the README and shown as a live diagram in the settings page.

### Settings UI overhaul
- Rebuilt the config page as a tabbed layout (Info / API Keys / Videos - Movie / Videos - TV / Audios - Music) with collapsible sections.
- Per-field-type mapping tables letting you choose exactly which Encora/StageMedia field feeds each Jellyfin field (Overview, Tagline, Studio, Production Location).
- Click-to-insert title format variable palettes with live previews, for every title field (Movie, Series, Season, Episode, Artist, Album, Track).
- Per-library scoping: restrict matching to specific Jellyfin libraries instead of every library of that type.
- "Preserve manually edited descriptions" toggle so admin edits aren't silently overwritten.
- "Respect existing embedded title/track number/artwork" toggle for Music, so real ID3 tags and cover art aren't clobbered.

### Reliability
- Encora API rate limiting is now driven by Encora's own response headers (`X-RateLimit-*`, `Retry-After`) instead of a guessed client-side limit.
- Fetched recordings are now cached and de-duplicated by ID, so Movie/Series/Season/Episode/Artist/Album/Track items that resolve to the same Encora ID share one HTTP call instead of firing redundant requests - this also avoids inconsistent results when a subset of a large batch would otherwise hit a transient failure.
- The plugin now automatically keeps itself (and StageMedia, for Movie posters) enabled in a library's own metadata/image fetcher allow-list whenever you enable/scope that library in the plugin's settings, instead of requiring a manual step in Jellyfin's Manage Library screen.
- StageMedia poster search now also works for TV Series/Season (previously Movie-only), sharing the same show-level poster pool.
- Optional auto-refresh scheduled task to periodically re-check already-matched items for upstream Encora changes.

### Fixes
- Corrected Season/Episode ordering so items sort chronologically without showing a nonsensical date-encoded number as the season/episode index.
- Episode/Album overviews now default to notes only instead of repeating the full show description on every single date; Series/Artist still show the full show description.
- `{master}` now falls back to "Unknown" instead of vanishing when Encora has no recorder on file.
- Fixed Season/Series folder scanning to recognize DVD-sourced `.vob`/`.ifo` files.
- Various analyzer/version fixes; bumped to the Jellyfin 10.11 SDK (.NET 9).

### Breaking change
- **Requires Jellyfin `10.11.0` or later.** The plugin is now built against .NET 9 to match Jellyfin 10.11+, and will not load on older servers.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pekempy/Jellyfin.Plugin.Encora/compare/1.0.0.1...1.1.0.0

## What's Changed
* Updated readme by @KristAude in https://github.com/pekempy/Jellyfin.Plugin.Encora/pull/1
* Update README.md by @KristAude in https://github.com/pekempy/Jellyfin.Plugin.Encora/pull/2
* Refactored to remove NFOMetadataProvider separately and incorporate the logic into the Encora Provider.
* Change thumb generation to be a random time during the video (15-60% of duration) to handle shorter highlight videos

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pekempy/Jellyfin.Plugin.Encora/compare/1.0.0.0...1.0.0.1

### Initial Release
The first release of the Encora agent for Jellyfin!

#### Features:
- Fetch from Encora based on the ID
- Fetch headshots 
- Download subtitles (may need a second 'refresh' for new files after downloading)
- Customise the names of your library
- Fetch posters from stagemedia
